# Codex CLI zh-CN localization fork

> Unofficial, separate Simplified Chinese interactive TUI for OpenAI Codex, preserving official commands and state boundaries.

## Required agent entry
- [Agent start](AGENT_START_HERE.md): ask language/component choices, inspect read-only, obtain confirmation, execute, verify.
